name: Kaname Watches
description: Kaname Watches — a WooCommerce store theme for a small mechanical-watch shop with one glass counter and a short list of never more than twelve watches. White ground, black ink, a taupe caption bar (#A09281 at 60%) and low-key photography; the home page opens on a framed two-pane window whose photographs crossfade (the watch, then the wrist) with four square photograph tiles directly under it, then a parallax photograph of three watches on the felt tray, five watches in one row with vertical category tabs, how the shop chooses, two watches told in full with 4.25rem names, the bench prices and a visit panel. Hanken Grotesk capitals for headings, Onest for reading. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours.

fonts.role: display: every heading, navigation, labels, prices and buttons (variable 100-900, Latin subset)

summary.en: A mechanical-watch shop: a framed two-pane window of crossfading photographs, a taupe caption bar, four square tiles and a five-watch strip.
